steps.what: Filter regulatory affairs items that are environmental.
Summarise the environmental issue in each item.

loop.check: the summary quotes the item and adds no limit
loop.stop: stop when every item is summarised or rejected
loop.why_not_simpler: the item is prose, and a keyword rule invents a threshold

steps.what: Mark which environmental trends to keep watching.
Store the watch list the manager marked.

tasks.design: Environmental items from sources the manager named are filtered in {DOCS}. A summary may quote the item and may not add a limit. The regulatory affairs manager marks what to watch. The stored list is that marked version. An item with no mark is not stored as a trend.
tasks.previous_blocker: Environmental notices were mixed with every other regulatory mail, so a packaging rule was seen late.
tasks.enabler_now: A source list can keep environmental items in their own queue.
tasks.still_hard: A notice that is environmental only in its effect, and a threshold the text does not state.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell a notice that changes a product from one that only changes a report.

ambition.what: Each environmental item on the named feed is marked watch or ignore in the week it appears.

tasks.altitude: The environmental queue is separate. The mark is the manager's. The stored list cannot grow by itself.

reach.task: Queue an environmental notice and mark whether it changes a product.
reach.learn: The queue can be filtered. The mark stays with the manager.

evidence.claim: A filter can separate environmental items and a summary can quote them. It cannot decide the trend.
A summary must not add a limit the item does not state. The watch list is stored only after the manager marks it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.
Fields: Source id and item id, produced by the named source list. An item from an unknown source is not summarised. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use sources the manager has already named.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Which environmental sources are in scope.
How long an ignored item is kept.
research_questions: Which sources are already named for environmental items?
What share were product rules rather than site rules?

already_counted.description: The manager still marks the trends.

incremental.description: The manager rejects a summary that added a limit.

approvals.approved_version: watch-list version and the item ids the manager marked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the filter and the quote summary. It shrinks when the source list is wrong and the manager reads the notices. The marking time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Judge green packaging and restricted substances.

steps.what: Check listed substances in packaging against the restricted list.
Evaluate toxic substances, carbon issues, and green policy.
Record the green evaluation the manager made.

tasks.design: Substances named on the packaging recipe are checked against the restricted list in {DOCS}. A substance that is not on the recipe stops the check. The regulatory affairs manager evaluates toxic substances, carbon, and green policy. A carbon figure is used only when it is already in the file. The screen does not call the pack green.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recipes were read against a restriction list in a drawer, and carbon numbers were copied from a slide.
tasks.enabler_now: A named substance can be matched to a restriction the company already holds.
tasks.still_hard: A substance named only as a trade name, and a carbon claim with no figure in the file.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see a recipe that is unrestricted and still a poor packaging choice.

ambition.what: A listed substance that matches a restriction is flagged the day the recipe is filed, and the packaging choice stays with the manager.

tasks.altitude: Hits are flagged for named substances. The evaluation stays with the manager. No green label is applied by the screen.

reach.task: Match a substance to a restriction and leave the packaging choice to the owner.
reach.learn: The match can be a list. The evaluation cannot.

evidence.claim: A list can match a named substance to a restriction. It cannot evaluate a packaging choice or invent a carbon figure.

A drafted sentence may cite only a rule or a figure already in the file. A sentence with neither stops and the manager rewrites it. Calling a pack compliant or green is the manager's evaluation. A missing substance stops the check rather than passing it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Recipe id, substance id, and restriction id, produced by the recipe and the restriction list. A substance with no id stops the check. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the restriction list the company already holds. Do not insert a carbon number that is not in the file.
unknowns: Which restriction list applies in which market.
Whether carbon figures exist for this pack.
research_questions: Are recipe substances stored as ids or as trade names?
Who may call a pack green?

already_counted.description: The manager still evaluates the pack.
The manager still records the evaluation.

incremental.description: The manager adds a substance id when the recipe uses a trade name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the match for substances that already have ids. It disappears when the recipe uses trade names and the manager reads it. The evaluation remains, so the net stays limited.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess electronic publishing with the agency.

steps.what: List the agency notes on electronic publishing of submissions.
Evaluate publishing systems and confer with regulatory agencies.
Write the recommendation after the conference.

tasks.design: Agency notices already collected are listed from {DOCS} and the {GOV_PORTAL} page the manager named. The regulatory affairs manager evaluates the publishing approach and confers with the agency. The recommendation is that person's writing. The screen does not select a publishing system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Format news was a link in mail, and the conference happened without the latest notice.
tasks.enabler_now: Notices already collected can be one list before the call.
tasks.still_hard: A notice that is not on the named page, and a system choice that depends on the agency's answer.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can hear that a notice which looks final is still a draft.
tasks.altitude: The notices are listed. The evaluation and the conference stay with the manager. No publishing system is chosen by the screen.

reach.task: Read an authority's filing notice and confer before changing the channel.
reach.learn: The notice list can be prepared. The conference cannot.

evidence.claim: A list can show notices already collected. It cannot evaluate a publishing system or confer with an agency.
The choice of how submissions are published electronically is the manager's recommendation after the conference. The screen must not select it.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A regulatory affairs manager at a European product company. National product rules apply. A checklist does not authorise a product.

Fields: Notice id and agency id, produced by the notice list. An agency with no collected notice shows an empty list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the notices and the portal page the manager has already named.
unknowns: Which agencies publish electronic format news.
Who else must agree before a publishing change.
research_questions: What would make the manager refuse a format?

already_counted.description: The manager still confers with the agency.
The manager still writes the recommendation.

incremental.description: The manager adds a notice the list missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the notice list. It disappears when the notices are not collected and the manager gathers them for the call. The conference time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Environmental items and listed substances can be checked against a file. The manager still marks the trend, still judges the packaging choice, and still talks to the agency about publishing systems.
reach: Chief sustainability officers compare a substance list to a restriction the company has adopted.
Compliance managers evaluate a filing channel with the authority before anyone relies on it.
skills_to_grow: Stop a packaging check when a substance is not on the list.
Treat an agency note on electronic publishing as news to read, not as a system choice.
role.ambitious_version: A listed substance that is restricted is flagged the day the recipe is filed, and the publishing system is still chosen after the manager confers with the agency.
